I. A cone has radius 10 and height 6. Find its volume divided by π.
II. A hemisphere has radius 10. Find its total surface area divided by π.
III. A cone and cylinder share radius 10 and height 30. Find the cylinder-to-cone volume ratio.
questions.explanation: I. V=πr²h/3. Answer: 200. II. Add curved area 2πr² and circular base πr². Answer: 300. III. For equal base radius and height, a cone has one-third of the cylinder volume. Answer: 3.

questions.question:
Solve these three tasks. Which option lists the answers in order?
I. A sphere has radius 30. Find its volume divided by π.
II. A sphere of radius 30 is melted into a cylinder of radius 30. Find the cylinder height.
III. A cylinder has radius 8 and height 3. Find its volume divided by π.
questions.explanation: I. V=4πr³/3, and r=3n. Answer: 36000. II. Equate 4πr³/3 to πr²h, giving h=4r/3. Answer: 40. III. V=πr²h, so V/π=r²h. Answer: 192.

questions.question:
Solve these three tasks. Which option lists the answers in order?
I. A cylinder has radius 10 and height 20. Find curved surface area divided by π.
II. A cylinder has radius 10 and height 11. Find its total surface area divided by 2π.
III. A cone has radius 8 and height 6. Find its volume divided by π.
questions.explanation: I. CSA=2πrh=4πn². Answer: 400. II. TSA=2πr(r+h), so divide by 2π. Answer: 210. III. V=πr²h/3. Answer: 128.

questions.question:
Solve these three tasks. Which option lists the answers in order?
I. A cone has radius 30 and height 40. Find its slant height.
II. A cone and cylinder share radius 10 and height 30. Find the cylinder-to-cone volume ratio.
III. A sphere has radius 24. Find its volume divided by π.
questions.explanation: I. l=√(r²+h²), a scaled 3-4-5 right triangle. Answer: 50. II. For equal base radius and height, a cone has one-third of the cylinder volume. Answer: 3. III. V=4πr³/3, and r=3n. Answer: 18432.
